he: הַ֥לְלוּ־יָ֨הּ ׀ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְל֗וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
en: Praise Yah — praise, O servants of Havayah; praise the name of Havayah.

he: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
en: May the name of Havayah be blessed, from now and forever.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of Havayah is praised.

he: רָ֖ם עַל־כׇּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃
en: Exalted above all nations is Havayah; above the heavens is His glory.
Who is like Havayah our Elokim, who sits enthroned on high,
who looks down low to see, in the heavens and on the earth;

he: מְקִ֥ימִ֣י מֵעָפָ֣ר דָּ֑ל מֵ֝אַשְׁפֹּ֗ת יָרִ֥ים אֶבְיֽוֹן׃
en: He raises the poor from the dust, from the dungheap He lifts the needy,
to seat them with nobles — with the nobles of His people.

he: מֽוֹשִׁיבִ֨י ׀ עֲקֶ֬רֶת הַבַּ֗יִת אֵֽם־הַבָּנִ֥ים שְׂמֵחָ֗ה הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}
en: He settles the barren woman of the house as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah.
